GETTING SWOLE AS A GRAPPLER BY GORDON RY.overview: Gordon Ryan's strength and nutrition course in three volumes (about 3 hours), made after he went from around 163 lb to 232 lb and back down. Volume 1 covers his approach to weight gain and cutting, with nutritionist input (Nathalia Santoro) and supplements. Volume 2 covers stretching and his gym exercises by body part (chest, back and others). Volume 3 covers food shopping and meal prep, with recipes.
GETTING SWOLE AS A GRAPPLER BY GORDON RY.for: Grapplers who want to gain muscle or manage weight around training.

Giancarlo Bodoni - See the back take the.overview: Two-time ADCC champion Giancarlo Bodoni (a New Wave / Danaher student) on turning guard passing into back takes, six volumes (about 3.5 hours). Volume 1 sets the context: why the back is the goal, and how opponents defend. Volume 2 covers beating the far hip (chair sit, trapping the bottom arm). Volume 3 covers preserving the back once you have it (rolling back take against 4-point, switching to the front headlock). Volume 4 covers when they turn in (claw grip roll-through, far side spin, countering the guard pull). Volume 5 covers back takes from half guard (claw roll-through, half nelson wrist ride, reach back). Volume 6 covers knee on belly (windshield wiper knee ride, 'ashi bolo') and double scoop passing to the back.
Giancarlo Bodoni - See the back take the.for: No-gi passers who pass but don't get to the back.
key: Back takes from half guard and knee on belly

Giancarlo Bodoni Submission Mastery - Om.overview: Giancarlo Bodoni's modern no-gi omoplata in five parts (about 2h 45m). Part 1 builds the conditions for the omoplata and solves the posture problem. Part 2 covers finishing mechanics (standard finish, 'heisting' finish, roll-through finish). Part 3 covers positional interplay: near-side roll, side control, mount and re-attacking ('reomoplata'). Part 4 covers auxiliary submissions from the omoplata (triangle variations, belly-down and backside armbars). Part 5 covers triangle entries, the failed ushiro (rear) roll and the body lock.
Giancarlo Bodoni Submission Mastery - Om.for: No-gi players who reach the omoplata but can't finish or follow up.
key: Triangles and armbars off the omoplata

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's analysis series for ADCC 2017, in eight unlabelled parts. In this series he reviews his preparation and matches from 2017, his first ADCC, where he won the -88kg silver and the absolute bronze, explaining his strategy, the positions he used and the mindset behind them. A related BJJ Fanatics product, the '2017 ADCC Scrimmage Analysis', covers his training rounds against Romulo Barral, Xande Ribeiro, Keenan Cornelius, Cyborg, Craig Jones and others, plus match commentary; your files may be that course or a combined version, so check the first part.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Gordon Ryan fans and students of no-gi strategy.
sources: https://bjjfanatics.com/products/my-evolution-your-revolution-2017-adcc-scrimmage-analysis-by-gordon-ryan (5 volumes; your copy has 8 parts, so it isn't matched file by file)

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's breakdown of his ADCC 2019 double gold run (-99kg and absolute), one or two matches per volume across eight volumes. Each match is shown and then broken down: Ben Hodgkinson, Tim Spriggs, Lucas Barbosa, Vinicius Gazola, Pedro Marinho, Garry Tonon, a two-volume study of the final against Lachlan Giles (the leg exchange, guard passing, mount and back take), and the absolute final against Buchecha (including the shoulder crunch analysis).
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Anyone studying how the techniques work at the highest level.
